name: VeRi-776
description: Vehicle re-identification dataset with 776 identities, 20 cameras, and about 50k images. VehicleID (Liu et al., ECCV 2016) is part of the same loader family. Open research terms; no data is vendored.
citation: VeRi: A Large-scale, Real-world Vehicle Re-identification Benchmark. Liu et al., CVPR 2016.
